text:
jess: Quick heads-up — we're going to push a relabel + golden patch for the 'protoflow' promptset this afternoon. Target window 16:30-17:15 PT.

omar: What's the scope? number of samples and what changed in the gold?

jess: ~2.1k samples total. Majority are short instruction-follow pairs where we saw label drift vs the new qint8 sim. Golden changes: tightened scoring rubric for ambiguous completions + added 120 microgoldens for multistep prompts.

lina: Labeler capacity check: we have 8 active QA labelers til 17:00, can extend 2 of them to 18:30 if needed. ETA to finish relabeling batch of 2.1k with that crew ~6-7 hours though.

todd: Can we slice and prioritize? I suggest: 1) microgoldens first, 2) samples that caused quant regressed scoring in last qbench run, 3) the rest. That cuts initial manual pass to ~1.2k.

sara: Also add a tiny holdout of 200 examples for regression tracking across qint8->int4 transition. We should not include holdout in golden but keep for evals.

jess: Good call. Plan: microgoldens (120) + qbench-regressors (~1.1k) + 200 holdout (not labeled into golden) => leave remainder for overnight batch. Does that work, @lina?

lina: Ok we can do microgoldens + qbench ones today if we have the pre-dedupe set. Need the dedup rules applied first or labelers will waste time.

omar: Dedupe: using fuzzyhash threshold 0.85 plus exact tokenizer-hash second pass. I pushed a job to /s3/curation/protoflow/dedupe_v3/ — checksum: sha256:3b9f... If you need sample list: s3 link in #eng-ml-assets.

jess: Perfect. @todd can you confirm the job finished and share the post-dedupe counts?

todd: Job finished. Pre-dedupe 2143, post-dedupe 1788. Microgoldens intact. I've uploaded post-dedupe CSV: s3://redwood-curation/protoflow/post_dedupe_1765432111.csv

lina: With post-dedupe 1.8k we can do microgoldens + qbench-regressors (~1.0k). We'll reserve 200 holdout before labeling. Start time for labelers 16:40 PT.

sara: Small note: the microgoldens include a new edge-case bucket: tokenization artifacts from long code blocks. Please flag anything that looks like deid leakage.

jess: We'll also run golden-bot validation after labeling. golden-bot: when we finish labeling, can you run the regression diff against last golden?

golden-bot: scheduled: run-golden-diff --set protoflow --baseline 2026-02-18 --candidate 1765432111_label_v1 --notify @jess @omar @sara; estimated runtime 12m.

omar: After golden diff, if delta > 1.5% regression on crit metric, we freeze rollout and triage. Otherwise we roll to canary (5% sample traffic) and monitor eval harness for 24h.

todd: For rollout infra: update canary config to prefer original fp16 model as fallback and route qint8 only if latency < 120ms. Will create PR to infra with the config.

lina: Labelers starting now. I'll post quick status updates every 30m in this thread.

jess: Thanks all. If anything blocks (missing manifests, bad CSVs), tag this thread. I'll do the rollout decision at ~18:00 PT after golden-bot and initial eval checks.

lina: 17:05 update: microgoldens done (120/120). qbench-regressors 420/1000 labeled. Found ~14% ambiguous rate — sending examples to jess for rubric clarification.

jess: Sent rubric clarifications and 6 annotated examples to the labelers. Re: ambiguous rate — lowering threshold for 'partial credit' on multi-step can reduce churn.

sara: tagging for traceability: added metadata field protoflow.relabel.run_id=1765432111 and note about qint8 baseline.

golden-bot: update: run-golden-diff completed. Summary: overall crit_metric delta = -0.8% (regression), ambiguity metric +1.4%. Detailed report at s3://redwood-curation/protoflow/reports/1765432111_diff.html

omar: -0.8% is within tolerance. Proceed to canary if no major content regressions in the report. I'll skim report now.

todd: PR for canary routing opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4512 — config attached.

jess: 18:03 decision: proceed to 5% canary rollout. Monitor and reconvene 24h or earlier if alerts. Thanks team. :rocket:
